The Plymouth Brethren christian church has rejected claims it coordinated volunteers and a campaign for the Coalition, and that it secretly paid far-right figures to stage stunts against the prime minister and other Labor MPs. events.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
events.description: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

events.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
events.description: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.

events.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
events.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

events.title: Germany, France agree on deal to support Europe's struggling car industry
events.description: The two countries said the agreement aimed to safeguard Europe's automotive industry, encouraging development and research. Automakers in Europe have so far struggled to compete with Chinese electric car companies.

events.title: Pope Leo recovering from surgery, will deliver Sunday prayer
events.description: The Vatican has said that Pope Leo XIV is recovering from lung surgery. Photos released on Friday showed the pontiff celebrating Mass at Rome's Gemelli Hospital unaided.

events.title: At summit, EU leaders pledge support for Ukraine's Zelenskyy
events.description: President Zelenskyy has received words of encouragement from EU leaders, who pledged support for Ukraine's self-defense against Russia. This comes as winter approaches and the US seems to be withdrawing support.

events.title: The EU wants an AI revolution. But on whose terms?
events.description: As the US and China race ahead, the European Union seeks to boost its economy with AI. Can it compete while protecting workers, safety and the climate?

events.title: India's young workers have a new colleague: AI
events.description: Artificial intelligence is changing the way Indian workplaces operate — raising questions about productivity, skills and entry-level jobs.

events.title: Italy prolongs Schengen suspension with Spain, talks loom
events.description: Italy has extended by another week ​its suspension of the European Union's border-free travel arrangements with Spain over a surge in migrant arrivals in Ceuta in late July, ​an ‌Italian government source said on Friday. A ⁠Spanish government spokesperson said the interior ministers of both countries would work over ‌the coming week on lifting the border controls.

events.title: South African rugby player Hyron ​Andrews dies in France ahead of Champions Cup debut
events.description: Hyron ​Andrews, a 31-year-old rugby player for the Lions team, was found dead at a hotel in France on Friday, the day before the South African club ​are due to play La Rochelle in the Champions Cup. The match will go ahead in his honour, his team said.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV celebrates mass in hospital while recovering from lung cancer operation
events.description: Pope Leo XIV celebrated a mass at Rome's Gemelli hospital Friday after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous tumour from his right lung, photos released by the Vatican showed. Doctors said his recovery was progressing normally but that further tests would show whether the cancer had spread.

events.title: 🔴Follow live: 'Ukraine is dependent on Starlink', Zelensky says in Brussels
events.description: No description available.

events.title: How books are being scanned and destroyed to train artificial intelligence
events.description: To train artificial intelligence models, millions of physical books are being digitised and destroyed. Our colleagues at France 2 investigate this controversial practice and the risk of seeing many rare second-hand books disappear forever.

events.title: Pope calls Putin urging Ukraine truce days after lung cancer surgery
events.description: The Pope spoke to Russian President Vladimir Putin on Friday and urged a truce with Ukraine as he continued his recovery from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said.

events.title: Drugs fuelling 'horrific' events seen in Waterford, says Irish justice minister
events.description: People who take illegal drugs are "supporting the horrific events we saw in Waterford", Irish justice minister Jim O'Callaghan has said.

events.title: Nicolas Maduro and wife deny new torture charges as 'false accusations'
events.description: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has rejected newly unsealed torture allegations against him and his wife as "false accusations".

events.title: EU leaders push back on a major budget proposal, putting a deal by 2027 in doubt
events.description: European Union leaders are voicing strong opposition to a new proposal for the bloc’s long-term budget

events.title: Ex-leader of N. Ireland’s largest unionist party sentenced to 15 years for sex abuse
events.description: The former leader of Northern Ireland’s largest unionist party has been on Thursday to 15 years in prison for the rape and sex abuse of two girls decades ago

events.title: Guterres urges faster action and financing to stop biodiversity loss
events.description: The United Nations Secretary-General appealed on Friday for governments, businesses and communities to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity for future generations and all life on Earth.

events.title: FBI returns 'Most Wanted' fraudster to US after India arrest in alleged $600K SNAP food stamp scheme
events.description: FBI Director Kash Patel announced Manjit Singh Bedi, accused of stealing over $600,000 in SNAP benefits in Tacoma, has been returned from India.

events.title: Horse farm owner gets life in prison for boyfriend's murder after claiming self-defense
events.description: Caylen Deller claimed she shot Chad Mullen in self-defense at her Florida horse farm, but the jury rejected her testimony after just one hour.

events.title: Florida mom vanished after 'People's Court' airing, now ex-fiancé is arrested on murder charge 15 years later
events.description: Dale Smith Jr. was arrested on second-degree murder charge 15 years after Michelle Parker vanished the day their dispute aired on "The People's Court."

events.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says everyone had phones as defense seeks only his records
events.description: Holdout juror Michael Desronvil reveals surveillance footage of journalists snooping through his mail and peering into windows after Clancy's mistrial.

events.title: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother
events.description: President Donald Trump revealed Pope Leo XIV's brother is a friend and avid MAGA supporter with memorabilia "all over" his house while wishing the pontiff well.

events.title: Pope Leo undergoes blood tests, X-ray following cancer surgery, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV began walking and resumed eating after thoracic surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, with blood tests and an X-ray being part of his recovery.

events.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage." Doctors later confirmed he had a form of lung cancer.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
